dogecoin.text: @Thibmancg Sorry, Dogecoin was removed from the wallet a few months ago and we don’t have any plans to put it back in.
@BittyCryptonius We all love the mighty DOGE (seriously, what's not to love about DOGE! 🐕🐕🐕), but we won't bring it back soon. Read more about it here: https://t.co/5Cpg5t2YZl
@GhostwalkerPh We used to have DOGE in Exodus, but had to remove it due to the lack of development support; See here for an explanation: https://t.co/6RGip1gGwD
@dogecoin_devs @ummjackson @BittyCryptonius Awesome, will make sure its gets to the right people 😄 ^TC
@dogecoin_devs @ummjackson @BittyCryptonius Hey guys, would you be able to shoot us this in an email to support AT https://t.co/JjnDS5Zpsu? That way I can forward on to the dev team 👌 ^TC

@BittyCryptonius @ummjackson To avoid any misinformation, the reasons the decisions were made are outlined via https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV . The last thing I would want to do is misrepresent anything said between our team at the time and the Doge team. There is nothing but love for Doge over here ^PB
@Canibaloler Hi there! We stopped supporting Doge long ago. There is no plan as of now to add DOGE again to the #Exodus wallet. You can read more about our stance here: https://t.co/0o34r2QDB1 ^CG

@IRodebush @siragusaazarado That's a very good question Isaac! We have a great article on how to move your doge off here: https://t.co/nLKLJ6z99d. If you have any trouble, please email support AT https://t.co/JjnDS5Zpsu and one of our support team will be more than happy to assist you! -KC
@CryptoDende @dogecoin Hi there, DOGE was removed from Exodus long time ago and this article explains in detail why that tough decision was made: https://t.co/eQXLGmNqGx - SS
@CaciquePM @dogecoin Hi there, DOGE was removed from Exodus long time ago and this article explains in detail why that tough decision was made: https://t.co/eQXLGmNqGx - SS
@dragonwolftech Hay Jason- we actually previously supported DOGE, but it was dropped awhile back. You can read more on this decision here: https://t.co/GNMr7yiftv ^TC
@mannothot91 We discontinued support for $DOGE in a previous release. You can read more about this decision here: https://t.co/eQXLGmNqGx ^TC
@KBeeyor @BrainHarrington @monerocurrency Hello there! Bringing back Doge is not in our plans at the moment. You can learn more about why we delisted it here: https://t.co/eD3Ep43JJT ^CG

@fabiodacruz67 Hi there! Although we love Dogecoin, we had to remove support due to it not having the latest updates for Insight servers 😞. Here's a post with more details: https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV -KC
@beck_on_tech Hey there- while we did previously support $DOGE, we don't currently have plans to implement back into Exodus. You can find more info on this decision here: https://t.co/GNMr7yiftv ^TC
@ngalekat @coinlaffs Thanks for the feedback. We don't have plans to bring back DOGE currently, but that could change. You can find more info on our decision here; https://t.co/GNMr7yiftv ^TC
@dineroonline85 Hi there- DOGE support was actually dropped from a previous version of Exodus. You can read more about this decision here: https://t.co/GNMr7yiftv ^TC

@ShapeShifter499 @dogecoin_devs @ummjackson @BittyCryptonius Hi there! We do not have any plans to bring the DOGE back into Exodus at the moment. But that doesn't mean it will never happen! Stay tuned and keep your 👀 on the roadmap: https://t.co/LC3etlC7Ze ^CG

@UJMachado Hello Ulice! Exodus dropped support for dogecoin in release 1.34.1. There is no way to add tokens manually. You can read our official announcement about this decision on this Reddit post: https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV +dz
@gamefinktv Hi there, great question! I don't believe DOGE will return anytime soon, but never say never 👍. I do miss our Exodus Dogecoin skin. -KC

@Nickfost_ If an asset doesn't work properly, we won't keep it in the wallet for new users. Just to be clear, your funds won't be lost from an asset removal since you own your private keys with Exodus. If someone still had Doge in Exodus, we have a guide here: https://t.co/eQXLGmNqGx -KC
@Nickfost_ Hi Nick! We don't support Doge anymore because its old insight was causing erratic wallet behavior for Doge holders. You can read more about it here: https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV -KC
@CarlosD3Freitas @dogecoin Thanks Carlos. What wallet do you use now to store DOGE? Do you exchange DOGE for other assets? +dz

@CarlosD3Freitas @dogecoin Hi Carlos. Dogecoin is not in our plans at the moment. We dropped support for it in Exodus 1.34.1. What is it that you love about Dogecoin and why would you like to see it in Exodus? What wallet do you use to store your DOGE in now? +dz https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV

@BittyCryptonius @ummjackson @swissrealale @dogecoin_devs @ShapeShift_io Mugs are frosting 😄. If you don't mind me asking, what timezone are you located in? Would you be willing to get on a call with me on Tuesday or Wednesday to talk and give me some feedback? -PB
@BittyCryptonius @ummjackson @swissrealale @dogecoin_devs @ShapeShift_io Umm, yes please! Much beer, so wow! -PB
@BittyCryptonius Hey Bitty! We had supported DOGE in the past but dropped support for it in version 1.34.0. 😔 More can be read on our official announcement here: https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV -PB

@TheShadowBanman @StellarOrg Hey there! Thanks a lot for the compliment! ❤️ There is no plans for Dogecoin right now, but please let me know what you like about this asset that makes you want to see it in Exodus! ^CG

@Marcos33541795 @FinnCLa @vergecurrency Hey there, Exodus stopped supporting Dogecoin over a year ago, you can read about it on Reddit. Thank you for the suggestion on #Sonm! We will check it out. -RS

@MSingularity @CEOofDogecoin @jprichardson @langer_hans @JRossNicoll My apologies, the r/ExodusWallet page is not officially run by Exodus so I was unaware that you were referring to conversations from the official post that was made in r/dogecoin. Users do indeed like options, and we are currently evaluating future possibilities. 😀 -PB

@CryptoAgent47 It was a really hard decision. For the short version, DOGE had server issues back then that affected the experience for the whole Exodus wallet. You can also read JP's post here: https://t.co/5Cpg5tkAnV. Now, we'll re-evaluate the asset and bring back the DOGE (hopefully) 🙏 -KC

@marcusriggs1 Hello there, Exodus is not designed to be installed and used on a USB flash drive. It only works on Windows, Mac, and Linux machines. Dogecoin is currently under Beta testing, watch out this space for more updates on full release! -SS

@Marcos33541795 @Changelly_team @sonmdevelopment @dogecoin Hey Patagonia, Although Sonm still has some listing requirements that it is yet to meet, I'll be more than happy to take note of your request. In regards to DOGE, I think that you'll be thrilled to hear that DOGE is currently in beta. Keep an eye out here for updates! -PB
@100xLightSpeed @BittyCryptonius So sorry for the confusion here! “Shibe” is dogespeak, and has nothing to do with Japanese. Here's some more information on this: https://t.co/6cEmWwOanM -PB

@lefebvredavid59 Thanks for the kind words ❤️ $XMR and $DOGE are currently in the Public Alpha testing wallet "Eden". We're putting them through their paces before making a decision to add them to Exodus. If you're not shy of Troubleshooting, join us in testing. -KM  https://t.co/1t8q8Y2N50
@Currency365 Hey there! Interesting choices. Dogecoin is currently being tested. I hope we can add it to Exodus soon! What makes you a fan of these particular assets? +dz

@BittyCryptonius @jprichardson @dogecoin_devs We want to ensure the best experience for our users and without constant development, doge is a bit harder to maintain on the backend. We do hope that it makes a change so we can add it back. - AM

@beyonddasunrise @wavesplatform Hello Happy 😊 Dogecoin is currently in beta and we're not sure when it will be added to Exodus. It's been in beta for quite some time and there are some strides that need to be made before we fully support it. I'm sorry I don't have better news for you. +dz

@TLaciana @wavesplatform Great question! Right now we are not looking to add Dogecoin to the wallet. Our developers are focusing on XMR and a few other assets as well as our Android app which is in development. - AM

@TLaciana Hi there! There has been no active development on the Dogecoin project for a long time. If this changes, we will make adding Doge more of a priority. If you need help moving your funds out, please write support[at]https://t.co/JjnDS5Zpsu
-NA

@TLaciana Hey there - it's cool to hear you're running a Dogecoin Core wallet. With Monero the added benefit regarding privacy is that nobody can see your address's balance and transaction history except you, which is not the case with most other crypto assets. -NA

@desstro74 Hi Brad, in the last six months we have added full-fledged Desktop support for the Cardano, Cosmos, Dogecoin, Nano, and Ontology blockchains. Other coins like Monero have also made the jump to Mobile. Stay tuned for more -- our asset engineers are on deck 🚢  --cc

Best,
CC

Catch ya later,
